ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows an NPN transistor bias circuit. The upper power supply is labeled V_CC = 10 V, and is connected through a resistor labeled 4R to the collector node C; the emitter E is grounded through a resistor labeled R; the base B is connected to the collector node through resistor R_B; the figure also labels β = 29. Reasoning: Let the base current be I_B. From β = 29, we can obtain I_C = 29I_B, and the emitter current I_E = I_C + I_B = 30I_B. Therefore the emitter voltage V_E = I_E R = 30I_B R. Since R_B provides base current from the collector node to the base, the current flowing through the upper 4R resistor is I_C + I_B = 30I_B. Therefore the collector voltage V_C = 10 - (30I_B)(4R) = 10 - 120I_B R. It is known that V_CE = V_CC/2 = 10/2 = 5 V, so V_C - V_E = 5, that is, (10 - 120I_B R) - 30I_B R = 5, giving 10 - 150I_B R = 5, therefore I_B R = 1/30. Thus V_E = 30I_B R = 1 V, and V_C = V_E + V_CE = 6 V. When the base-emitter junction is forward biased, V_BE = 0.7 V, so V_B = V_E + 0.7 = 1.7 V. The voltage across R_B is V_C - V_B = 6 - 1.7 = 4.3 V, therefore R_B = 4.3/I_B. Thus R_B/R = 4.3/(I_B R) = 4.3/(1/30) = 129.

method.method_draft: Let the base current be IB. From beta = 29, IC = 29IB and IE = 30IB, so VE = IE R = 30IB R. Since current through the 4R resistor is IC + IB = 30IB, VC = 10 - (30IB)(4R). Use the given condition VCE = VC - VE = 10/2 = 5 to solve for IB R. Then compute VB = VE + 0.7 and use RB = (VC - VB)/IB. Divide by R to obtain RB/R = 129.

method.method_draft: Let IE be the current through the emitter resistor. Because the 4R branch current supplies IC plus the feedback base current, it is also IE. method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中的电路为一个NPN晶体管偏置电路，顶部电源标为 VCC = 10 V；从 VCC 到集电极 C 有一个电阻 4R；发射极 E 通过电阻 R 接地；基极 B 通过电阻 RB 与集电极节点相连，形成集电极到基极的反馈偏置；图中还标出 β = 29。推理：已知 VCE = VCC/2 = 10/2 = 5 V。令发射极电阻 R 中的电流为 IE。由于 4R 支路电流在集电极节点分成集电极电流 IC 和经 RB 流入基极的电流 IB，而 IE = IC + IB，所以 4R 支路电流也等于 IE。沿电源到地列电压关系：VCC = IE(4R) + VCE + IE(R)。代入 VCC = 10 V、VCE = 5 V，得 10 = 4IE R + 5 + IE R，因此 5IE R = 5，IE R = 1 V。于是 VE = IE R = 1 V，VC = VE + VCE = 1 + 5 = 6 V。B-E 结正向偏置时 VBE = 0.7 V，所以 VB = VE + 0.7 = 1.7 V。RB 两端电压为 VC - VB = 6 - 1.7 = 4.3 V。又 β = 29，所以 IE = (β + 1)IB = 30IB，即 IB = IE/30。因此 RB/R = (4.3/IB)/R = 4.3/(IB R) = 4.3/((IE/30)R) = 4.3 × 30/(IE R) = 129。
